name: exists_ideal_in_class_of_norm_le
statement: ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) : ∃ I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰, ClassGroup.mk0 I = C ∧ absNorm (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ M K

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isPrincipal_of_pow_le_of_mem_primesOver_of_mem_Icc
statement: ∀ p ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊(M K)⌋₊, p.Prime → ∀ (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)), P ∈ primesOver (span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 K) → p ^ ((span ({↑p} : Set ℤ)).inertiaDeg P) ≤ ⌊(M K)⌋₊ → Submodule.IsPrincipal P) : IsPrincipalIdealRing (𝓞 K)

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isPrincipal_of_lt_or_isPrincipal_of_mem_primesOver_of_mem_Icc
statement: ∀ p ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊(M K)⌋₊, p.Prime → ∃ P ∈ primesOver (span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 K), ⌊(M K)⌋₊ < p ^ ((span ({↑p} : Set ℤ)).inertiaDeg P) ∨ Submodule.IsPrincipal P) : IsPrincipalIdealRing (𝓞 K)

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_of_abs_discr_lt
statement: |discr K| < (2 * (π / 4) ^ nrComplexPlaces K * ((finrank ℚ K) ^ (finrank ℚ K) / (finrank ℚ K)!)) ^ 2) : IsPrincipalIdealRing (𝓞 K)

have_tree.body: finrank_pos -- Lean needs to know this for `positivity` to succeed
